Package io.mavlink4j.session

Interface MessageFilter

public interface MessageFilter
A predicate a Dispatcher subscription tests every decoded frame against. The statics cover the filters a MAVLink microservice actually needs; a caller with a bespoke need can still implement this interface directly (it is a single abstract method).

Thread-safety: Filters are called on the receive thread for every frame, so implementations must be fast, side-effect free and thread-safe.
